items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: He wanted to play like Raul Aldrich played or play like Harry Jane played.

ctx.x: I think some, the German label Telephumpen produced some of your records. Yes, I have. Big Boy Boogie, and they re-released them or something in there. Did you record one?

Well, I recorded in Berlin in 53, and I was very disappointed. I've made one record with, you know, Frank Burley's blues or something. Yeah. And the other side, I forgot what it was. And I talked to the trumpet player that was supposed to make this record for me. I told him why they wanted it, and why we should have put on the wax was that. Well, he had never made no recording. He was very obedient for those, that first section of one, two sides. And after they put out that record, they sold it overnight in…
It wasn't until you came around here, was it, that you tried to not restore, but find that New Orleans element in your clarinet. Well, yes.
